notes: Strong, polished result: animated trips render over a dark CARTO basemap with mint/amber vendor palette, live metric counters (509→518 'on the move'), legend, activity histogram scrubber, play/pause, speed and trail-length controls; clock advances 20:12→20:37 across screenshots so animation runs on load with no console errors.

Uses deck.gl 8.9.36 and maplibre-gl 3.6.2 — dated v8-era stack rather than current 9.x; also a stray request to api.tiles.mapbox.com/mapbox-gl-js/v3.6.2/mapbox-gl.css was blocked (harmless but indicates dated/incorrect asset reference).

Trails render as near-uniform thick glowing lines with little visible fade, and the basemap is so dark that street context is almost invisible — the 'trail' effect and geographic grounding are weaker than the UI polish suggests.
